name: Microsoft Teams
summary: Chat, reply, schedule meetings, and create channels in Microsoft Teams via Composio.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Composio API key
preferences.description: API key from Settings -> API Keys in your Composio dashboard (app.composio.dev/settings/api-keys).

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_AUTH_CONFIG_ID
preferences.title: Auth config ID
preferences.description: Auth config ID for microsoft_teams from app.composio.dev/auth-configs.

preferences.name: VOICEOS_USER_ID
preferences.title: Composio user ID
preferences.description: Your Composio user identifier (e.g. default or your user ID).

tools.name: get_all_chats
tools.title: Get all chats
tools.description: Fetch all Microsoft Teams chats for the user. 1:1 chats have no topic, so to find a person's chat, check sender names with get_chat_messages. Use when the user asks for their Teams chats, recent conversations, or to list chat channels.

limit.description: Maximum number of chats to return (1-20, default 10)

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.title: Get chat messages
tools.description: Fetch recent messages from a Microsoft Teams chat thread. Use when the user asks to read messages from a chat, see what someone sent in Teams, or check conversation history.

top.description: Number of recent messages to retrieve (default 10)

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.title: Send chat message
tools.description: Send a direct message or group chat message in Microsoft Teams. Use when the user asks to send, text, or post a message to a person or chat in Teams.

recipient_name.description: Recipient or chat display name for UI display only

root.html: Send to

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.title: Reply to message
tools.description: Reply to a post in a Microsoft Teams team channel. Use when the user asks to reply to a channel post or thread in a team. Pass the post's link (from Copy link on the post in Teams) as message_link; the team, channel and message IDs are only a fallback. Only for team channels: to reply in a 1:1 or group chat, use send_chat_message in that chat.

message_link.description: Link to the channel post, from Copy link on the post in Teams. Contains the team, channel and message IDs.

team_id.description: Team ID. Not needed when message_link is given

channel_id.description: Channel ID within the team. Not needed when message_link is given

message_id.description: Root post ID to reply to. Not needed when message_link is given

root.html: Reply to thread

tools.name: create_online_meeting
tools.title: Create online meeting
tools.description: Schedule a new Microsoft Teams online meeting with start and end times. Use when the user asks to schedule a Teams meeting, set up a Teams call, or create an online calendar meeting.

start_date_time.description: Meeting start time in ISO 8601 with local offset (e.g. 2025-03-20T15:00:00-04:00)

end_date_time.description: Meeting end time in ISO 8601 with local offset (e.g. 2025-03-20T15:30:00-04:00)

root.html: Schedule Teams Meeting

tools.name: create_channel
tools.title: Create channel
tools.description: Create a new channel inside a Microsoft Teams team. Use when the user asks to create a channel, add a channel to a team, or set up a new Teams topic channel.

root.html:
Create Channel
